_note: Shape of knowledge/sources.local.json, which is gitignored because it describes a private Notion workspace. The sync-notion skill writes the real one.
_ingested_on: Date a page was first read, written once by sync-notion and never rewritten. It is what lets the readiness estimate measure how fast you are actually getting through the course; without it the coverage rate is unknowable and the estimate refuses. Pages ingested before this field existed keep null, meaning 'before the measurement window' -- they set the level of coverage but not the rate.
_cache: Path under knowledge/ holding the page's prose, written by sync-notion when it reads the page. It is what digest and quiz actually write from -- without it they compose from a heading plus general GCP knowledge, which reads synthetic and weakens rule 2. A page with ingested=true and no cache is a claim with no evidence, and validate.py warns.
_expected_exam_tags: Planning-only guess at what an un-ingested page will cover, used to answer 'how much would ingesting this pull the estimate in?'. Same class of object as coverage.md's add-next list: NEVER citable and never teachable, and excluded from coverage by construction, which is what keeps CLAUDE.md rule 3 intact.

sections.heading: <exact heading text, character for character>
sections.note: optional; NOT-YET-COVERED: ... for planning signal only
